Lesson details

Questions

Copy two or more columns from a spreadsheet: question → answer → wrong choices (optional) → hint (optional). One question per row. Separate wrong choices with a semicolon.

Plain text works too: put a tab between the question and answer. For sequences, separate answer steps with |.
